name: tabiji.ai API
description: Free REST API for AI-curated travel data — destinations, restaurant picks, itineraries, comparisons, a normalized catalog, and unified search. No API key required.

endpoints.description: All 6905 destinations with budget, season, vibes, and travel styles
Full picks guide with all places, ratings, hours, and quotes
Full comparison with structured verdicts, categories, and FAQs
Normalized entity catalog spanning destinations, picks, places, itineraries, and comparisons
All 20 country safety profiles (emergency numbers, advisories, healthcare, scams)
Full safety profile for one country (e.g., jp.json, th.json)
Travel advisory index for 208 countries (US State Dept + UK FCDO)
Combined US + UK travel advisory for one country
Filterable index of all 6975 destinations with normalized budget, season, vibes, safety, and practical dimensions
Dimension value counts for UI faceted search (continent, budget, safety, vibes, tap water)
Pre-computed recommendation sets for 10+ common travel query patterns

dataSource: Curated from Tabiji editorial pages, traveler discussions, and selective place enrichment. Records include cross-links plus provenance/freshness metadata.
license: Free for non-commercial use. Attribution appreciated: tabiji.ai
